name: UpdateComputeQuotaPlan

parameters.help_en: The nickname of the level-1 quota
parameters.name: nickname

parameters.help_en: The name of the quota plan
parameters.name: name

fields.help_en: The auto-scaling upper limit for general-purpose CPU computing of the level-1 quota, in CUs. The value must be a non-negative integer and cannot exceed the maxCU of the level-1 quota. A value of 0 indicates that auto-scaling is disabled. If you do not specify this parameter when you call the UpdateComputeQuotaPlan operation, the original value of the plan is retained. The auto-scaling upper limit of a level-2 quota for general-purpose CPU computing cannot exceed this value. If the upper limit is not configured, it is treated as 0 during validation. If you change the level-1 upper limit to 0, you must also explicitly set the upper limit to 0 in the same request for all level-2 quotas for general-purpose CPU computing that originally had a positive upper limit
fields.help_zh:
普通 CPU 计算一级 Quota 的自动弹性上限，单位为 CU。取值为非负整数，且不得超过一级 Quota 的 maxCU；0 表示关闭自动弹性。

调用 UpdateComputeQuotaPlan 时，不传该字段会保留该计划的原值。普通 CPU 计算二级 Quota 的自动弹性上限不得超过此值，校验时未配置的上限按 0 处理。将一级上限改为 0 时，原有正上限的普通 CPU 计算二级 Quota 也须在同一次请求中显式设为 0
fields.name: auto_scale_cpu_limit

fields.help_en:
The number of elastic reserved CUs for the level-1 quota.

The ElasticReservedCU of the level-1 quota must be a multiple of 50.
The ElasticReservedCU of the level-1 quota must be greater than or equal to 0.
The ElasticReservedCU of the level-1 quota must be less than or equal to the MaxCU of the level-1 quota
fields.help_zh:
一级Quota弹性预留CU值。

一级Quota ElasticReservedCU必须是50倍数
一级Quota ElasticReservedCU 大于等于0
一级Quota ElasticReservedCU 小于等于一级Quota MaxCU
fields.name: elastic_reserved_cu

fields.help_en: The properties of the level-1 quota
fields.name: parameter

fields.help_en: The nickname of the level-2 quota
fields.name: nick_name

fields.help_en: The auto-scaling upper limit for general-purpose CPU computing of the level-2 quota, in CUs. The value must be a non-negative integer and cannot exceed the auto-scaling upper limit of the level-1 quota. A value of 0 indicates that auto-scaling is disabled. If you do not specify this parameter when you call the UpdateComputeQuotaPlan operation, the original value of the plan is retained. If the upper limit is not configured, it is treated as 0 during validation. Therefore, if the level-1 upper limit is 0 or not configured, the upper limit of the level-2 quota for general-purpose CPU computing cannot be a positive number
fields.help_zh:
普通 CPU 计算二级 Quota 的自动弹性上限，单位为 CU。取值为非负整数，且不得超过一级 Quota 的自动弹性上限；0 表示关闭自动弹性。

调用 UpdateComputeQuotaPlan 时，不传该字段会保留该计划的原值。校验时未配置的上限按 0 处理，因此一级上限为 0 或未配置时，普通 CPU 计算二级 Quota 的上限不得为正数
fields.name: auto_scale_cpu_limit

fields.help_en:
The number of elastic reserved CUs.

The ElasticReservedCU of the level-2 quota must be greater than or equal to 0. 
The sum of the ElasticReservedCU of all level-2 quotas must be equal to the ElasticReservedCU of the level-1 quota
fields.help_zh:
弹性预留CU值。

二级Quota的ElasticReservedCU大于等于0 
二级Quota的ElasticReservedCU总和必须等于一级Quota ElasticReservedCU
fields.name: elastic_reserved_cu

fields.help_en:
The upper limit of reserved CUs.

The maxCU of the level-2 quota cannot exceed the maxCU of the level-1 quota
fields.help_zh:
预留CU上限。

二级Quota的maxCU不能超过一级Quota的maxCU
fields.name: max_cu

fields.help_en:
The guaranteed number of reserved CUs.

The sum of the minCU of all level-2 quotas must be equal to the minCU of the level-1 quota.
The minCU of the level-2 quota cannot exceed its own maxCU
fields.help_zh:
预留CU保障。

所有二级Quota minCU总和需要等于 一级Quota的minCU
二级Quota的minCU不能超过自身的maxCU
fields.name: min_cu

httpCode.description_en:
The HTTP status code.
1xx: Informational response. The request was received and is being processed.
2xx: Success. The request action was successfully received, understood, and accepted by the server.
3xx: Redirection. The request was redirected, and further action is required to complete the request.
4xx: Client error. The request contains invalid parameters, bad syntax, or cannot be fulfilled due to specific conditions.
5xx: Server error. The server failed to fulfill the request due to other reasons
httpCode.description_zh:
HTTP状态码。
1xx：信息响应 - 请求已接收，正在处理中。
2xx：成功 - 请求动作已被服务端成功接收、理解并接受。
3xx：重定向 - 请求被重定向，采取进一步行动以完成请求。
4xx：客户端错误 - 请求包含错误请求参、语法或特定请求条件无法满足。
5xx：服务端错误 - 服务器由于其他原因无法满足请求
